findings.summary: Clean designed evaluation sweep over 8 workflows, zero recovery actions fired: graph-loop.yml latest completed run 32861557668 'concluded success; no recovery'; physics-loop.yml 32866107906 same; intel-loop/product-loop/runtime-loop/cto-council all had an active run ('watchdog does not interrupt potentially valid work' — those active runs include this batch's 32880179571/32880285474); meta-sync.yml AND product-beta-repair.yml each reported 'no completed run to inspect' at 17:47Z, i.e. both workflows had ZERO completed runs at that timestamp (never-run or already-pruned lineage). Timestamped lane-state snapshot, useful only as provenance.

Recovery policy transcribed for convenience (authoritative source = workflow file at pinned head_sha): rerun --failed ONLY when logs prove (a) cancelled-by-runner-shutdown regex signatures, (b) explicit SPIDER_TRANSIENT_OX_EXHAUSTED marker, or (c) OpenCode/Ox usage PLUS transient-network regex (network_error/ECONNRESET/EAI_AGAIN/ETIMEDOUT/429/5xx/rate-limit/service-unavailable family); refuses blind retry when logs unreadable ('refusing blind retry'); never resurrects non-infrastructure failures; never interrupts workflows with an active run.
